jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 오수정화시설 lane `building-register-sewage-facility` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0496): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_register_sewage_facility already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows in sixteen buckets (the first hex digit of each row's SHA-256 key) and append to main only the rows it has not held and a removal marker per row it no longer holds (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the nearest measured neighbour on the same template unit (root ADR-0386): silver_refresh_building_permit_basis_outline 357 s for a 438 MB release of 6.53M rows; this lane's newest release is 342 MB of 6.62M rows (1.6 GB of text, measured 2026-11-11), so about the same work, taken as 1,200 s with the room for its sixteen bucket commits, inside the 150-minute limit

expected_outcome.basis: building HUB files are released monthly (expected_cadence monthly, 1080 h, in the endpoint catalog) plus one daily fallback; this lane's ledger holds five monthly releases 2026-06..10 (measured 2026-11-11, catalog.bronze_object)

assets.title: 건축물대장 오수정화시설
assets.description: 건축물대장의 오수정화시설마다 한 행: 오수정화방식(하수종말처리장연결·마을하수처리장연결·부패탱크방법·접촉폭기방법 등)·용량·대장종류. 필지의 하수 신호다 — 하수처리장연결은 공공하수도에 이어진 증거, 그 밖의 방식은 개인하수처리시설이다. 한 건물에 시설이 여럿이라 행 글자의 SHA-256 이 키다. 원문 29칸 보존. 필지 by-PNU 종류 parcel-utility 가 행의 PNU 로 필지의 인입 가능성 문서에 싣는다(루트 ADR-0496, ADR-0497).

dependencies.description: 건축물대장 오수정화시설(mart_djy_07) 29칸을 행마다 새 행·사라진 행만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0496).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub/VWorld export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145), not a raw provider code; parcels since merged, split or recoded are carried to the current pnu by the consumer through the place-identity resolver and views.changed_codes (ADR-0288, ADR-0329, ADR-0496)
